Transformational Change Manager | Financial Services | Copenhagen, Denmark

Are you ready to lead teams and drive impactful change at scale for financial services clients? Are you passionate about helping organizations successfully navigate transformation, and do you bring both strategic vision and hands-on delivery experience? Then the role of Transformational Change Manager in Copenhagen is your next career move. Let’s build the future of work—together.

About the Team and the Role

As a Manager within our Talent team, based in Copenhagen, Denmark, you will take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, client relationships, and account management, with financial services as your primary industry focus. You will guide teams in co-creating and implementing human-centered transformation strategies, develop change approaches that are agile and ready for the digital world, and ensure the realization of measurable business outcomes.

You will work primarily with leading financial services clients, including banks, insurance providers, and capital markets firms, partnering with them on digital, technology-driven, and organizational transformations. You will be part of multidisciplinary teams delivering large, complex programs, working closely with client teams and international colleagues to solve challenging organizational problems, lead key workstreams, guide junior colleagues, and deliver specific project outcomes. Explore our point of view and Talent offering here.

The Work

• Lead Transformation Journeys – Help financial services clients navigate complex transformations, building organizations that are more capable, resilient, and adaptable to redirection and ambiguity.

• Human-Centered Change Strategies – Translate strategic direction and business objectives into holistic, agile change strategies that address culture, ways of working, and readiness for the future.

• Deep Change Management Expertise – Drive leadership alignment to the change vision, activate change using insight-driven approaches leveraging AI, engage large-scale change networks, and prepare organizations for business readiness, technology adoption, and new ways of working.

• Workforce Reinvention – Shape organization design, reskilling, and upskilling strategies for new operating models (e.g., S/4HANA, GBS, human-agentic workforce) and prepare the workforce for emerging roles.

• Technology Enablement – Unlock the human potential of new technologies through enterprise-wide system implementations, digital learning platforms, and AI-enabled change activation.

• Data-Driven Insights – Use analytics and predictive tools to measure adoption, sentiment, and transformation impact.

• Stakeholder Engagement & Account Management – Build trusted relationships with C-level executives and client teams in financial services, oversee account health, and proactively identify opportunities to expand our footprint.

• Business Development – Build trusted client relationships, identifying new growth opportunities, supporting business development activities, and shaping go-to-market strategies.

You will also:

• Lead workstreams and coach junior colleagues, bringing together cross-functional teams and specialists.

• Collaborate with Financial Services clients, the Netherlands & Nordics Talent practice and Accenture’s international network of experts.

• Balance changing priorities and timelines while keeping delivery focused on practical, measurable outcomes.

• Contribute to an inclusive, supportive team culture and continue developing your expertise in Change & Transformation Management.

About You

You bring a background in management consulting, organizational change or business transformation, with experience delivering people-centered change in complex, technology-enabled programs. You understand the opportunities and challenges facing banks, insurers and capital markets firms as they modernize systems, redesign operating models and introduce new ways of working. Your project experience may include roles such as Change Manager, Transformation Lead, Organizational Change Lead, Change and Communications Lead or Business Project Manager.

You are passionate about the people side of transformation and about turning strategic ambitions into meaningful, measurable change. You can align leaders around a shared vision, engage stakeholders and change networks, and shape communication, training and adoption activities that help people embrace new technologies, processes and behaviors. You use data and feedback to assess readiness, measure adoption and improve your approach iteratively.

You are comfortable leading workstreams and multidisciplinary teams in fast-paced, complex environments, combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, coach junior colleagues and solve problems in a people-oriented, insight-driven way. Most importantly, you are a collaborative colleague who helps teams navigate uncertainty and achieve outcomes together.

Requirements

• 
5+ years of relevant experience in organizational change, future workforce and/ or Human Resources; for example, guiding organizations in their transformation journey, designing and implementing large-scale communication and training programs, or upskill leaders to carry out desired behaviors.

• 
Management consulting experience or experience working within Financial Services, is a plus, not a prerequisite

• 
Strong consulting skills and the ability to engage senior business and HR stakeholders

• 
Strong self-leadership, with experience leading workstreams, collaborating in teams and coaching junior colleagues

• 
Understanding of organizational change and transformation components and complexicty, preferably within financial services and knowledge of banking, insurance, or capital markets transformation challenges

• 
A commercial mindset, the ability to build trusted client networks and a focus on measurable business and workforce outcomes

• 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional project teams in a global environment

• 
Professional proficiency in English; Danish language skills is an advantage for local client engagement, but not a requirement

• 
Track record as people-oriented, insight driven and iterative problem solver

• 
A master’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, engineering, or behavioral and social sciences

What We Offer

• Membership in our growing Netherlands & Nordics Talent team, with access to a global network of experts at the forefront of talent reinvention

• The opportunity to shape your career around your aspirations, with regular support from your People Lead

• A competitive salary, bonus schemes, health insurance, an employee share purchase program, and other benefits

• A strong commitment to employee well-being and work-life balance, including flexible arrangements that support family life, mental health, and well-being

• A supportive, encouraging and fun team who always roots for one another

• Market-leading expertise, a steep learning curve and great opportunities for development

• Opportunities to participate in corporate citizenship initiatives, including volunteering, charity work, and Inclusion & Diversity networks

Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities: 

Your main responsibility will be to take end-to-end ownership of product development and evolution. You will:

• Own and drive product roadmaps aligned with Quadsat's strategy, market opportunities, and customer needs.
• Translate customer, operational, and commercial input into clear product priorities and development initiatives.
• Drive development from concept through implementation, validation, release, and continued improvement.
• Maintain an overview of scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and progress, and communicate product status clearly across the organisation.
• Work closely with engineers and technical leads to understand feasibility, effort, and realistic timelines for new capabilities and customer requests.
• Collaborate with the R&D Director on prioritisation, resource planning, and allocation of engineering capacity across product lines.
• Facilitate collaboration across R&D, Business Development, Marketing, Production, Quality, and other key stakeholders.
• Stay close to customers, partners, and the defence industry, working with the commercial organisation to understand emerging needs and translate them into product direction.
The role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we bring it to market, while remaining closely involved in the technical development required to make it happen.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in an engineering field, combined with strong practical experience in a similar role as a product or project manager.

In addition, you bring:

• Experience translating customer or market needs into technical products and development priorities.
• Experience within product management, technical product management, technical project management, or a similar role.
• Experience from the defence industry or another mission-critical technical domain.
• A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
• Fluency in English (both written and oral).

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities: 

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

• Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
• Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
• Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
• Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
• Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
• Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
• Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
• Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
• Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

• Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
• Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
• Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
• Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
• Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
• Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
• Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
• Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
• A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.
It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Restaurant Operations Manager

About Us

At Bagel Bites, we believe that good food, excellent customer service, and efficient restaurant management go hand in hand.

Following a restructuring of our management team, we are looking for a responsible, motivated, and flexible employee to take charge of the restaurant's daily operations.

The position combines restaurant management, kitchen duties, customer service, purchasing, and administrative responsibilities. The successful candidate must be willing to take an active role in all aspects of the restaurant's operations, including physically working in the kitchen.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the overall daily operation of the restaurant. Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Managing and coordinating the restaurant's daily operations.

• 
Supervising employees, delegating tasks, preparing work schedules, and ensuring efficient teamwork.

• 
Preparing and serving fast food, including sandwiches, burgers, bagels, and other menu items.

• 
Actively participating in kitchen activities, food preparation, cleaning, and maintaining hygiene standards.

• 
Purchasing raw materials, ingredients, and other necessary supplies for the restaurant.

• 
Managing inventory, monitoring stock levels, and ensuring the availability of necessary ingredients.

• 
Handling customer service, taking orders, and resolving customer inquiries or complaints.

• 
Developing and implementing marketing initiatives to promote the restaurant.

• 
Managing the company's social media accounts and online presence.

• 
Assisting with financial and administrative tasks, including budgeting, sales monitoring, reporting, and basic accounting.

• 
Ensuring compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene requirements, and company procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for a candidate who has:

• 
Relevant education or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, or the food service industry.

• 
Experience in kitchen operations and fast-food preparation.

• 
Good organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to manage employees and delegate responsibilities.

• 
Strong customer service and communication skills.

• 
Knowledge of purchasing, inventory management, and supplier coordination.

• 
Basic understanding of financial administration and accounting.

• 
Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and handle multiple tasks.

• 
A flexible and hands-on approach, with willingness to perform both managerial and practical kitchen duties.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to:

Email: info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com

Please use the subject line: "Application – Restaurant Operations Manager".

Build Continia’s test function from the ground up, and shape how we deliver quality across all our products.

Continia develops finance automation software built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, .NET, web and mobile technologies. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 20,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 1,800 reselling partners.

About the role

Our developers own the quality of their own code through unit and integration tests. What no single team owns today is the view across products. Does a change in one product affect another? Does the Continia Suite work as a whole? Are we ready to release? That is what this function is for, and you will be the one to build it.

You start by creating the roadmap. Where are our biggest quality challenges, which processes do we need, and what are the milestones? From there you build the function step by step. You keep it transparent where we are and when we need people from the product teams. You will work closely with our QA & Automation Engineer to decide what to automate and where AI can make our test processes faster.

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously.

• Opportunities for professional growth and learning.

_Compliance, built like product.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

In this role, you will own everything related to AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

**

**

• The Product Mindset: You are a product person at heart. You care about whether the AI actually solves the user's problem, not just if the loss curve is going down.

• High-Agency Builder: You prefer building systems over following manuals. You identify bottlenecks in our AI workflows and fix them before they become tickets.

• Technical Mastery: Strong skills in TypeScript (our core) and/or Python, with hands-on experience in frameworks like LangChain or equivalent orchestration layers.

• RAG & Vector Mastery: You’ve built production-grade RAG pipelines and understand the nuances of embedding, retrieval strategy, and re-ranking.

• Evaluation Obsession: You understand that "it works on my machine" doesn't apply to LLMs. You have experience setting up evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

• Cloud & Scale: Experience deploying AI services in AWS or containerized environments, ensuring they are scalable and cost-effective.

• Communication: You can explain the trade-offs of a specific model architecture to a founder and a technical bottleneck to a peer with equal clarity.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Open Source (LLaMA, Mistral).

• Stack: TypeScript, Python, LangChain, etc

• Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD for LLMs.

**

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

• Support our AI Adoption Program through campaigns, training sessions, onboarding of new users and community activities.

• Help analyse usage data and user feedback and turn insights into improvements and stories that inspire colleagues.

Building and experimenting with AI

• Test AI solutions and support evaluation of quality, grounding, responsible use and user feedback.

• Work collaboratively and are comfortable asking questions and seeking input.

Senior Manager for CMC API Cultivation Pilot Plant

Category:  Manufacturing

Location:

Bagsværd, Capital Region of Denmark, DK

Sr Manager

CMC Development

CMC API Pilots, Mammalian Pilot Plant

Location: Bagsværd

Your impact begins here**. Lead with purpose. Empower people.

**

Are you an authentic, resilient, and empathetic people leader who thrives on developing people, building trust, and ensuring operational excellence in a complex API production environment?

As our new Team Leader (Sr Manager) for the Mammalian Pilot Plants (MPP) Cultivation team, you will lead 15 dedicated scientists and technicians producing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) for clinical studies. You will play a key role in ensuring strong operations, fostering collaboration, and managing stakeholders across our API pilot production activities, from cultivation to recovery and purification. You will be a visible and approachable leader on the shopfloor, creating an environment built on psychological safety, trust, and teamwork. You will also join a close-knit leadership team where colleagues support, challenge, and inspire each other to succeed.

Ready to lead and make a difference? Apply today!

**

What you’ll do**

As Sr Manager of the mammalian cultivation team, you will lead a team responsible for daily operations in our cultivation facility. A key part of your success will be your ability to coordinate and engage in prioritization with your manager colleagues across the department to ensure high quality, production activities and team engagement.

Furthermore, you have a preference to set and meet ambitious goals on the premise that success is achieved through collaboration and sharing key observations early to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by being on shopfloor daily, visible to your employees and engaging in problem solving.

You will primarily be responsible for the cultivation of API for phase 1, 2 and 3 studies ensuring high quality and compliance. Your team consists of 15 employees (Scientists and Technicians) who are preparing, conducting, and reporting API production campaigns in close collaboration with the development and production areas of Novo.

You will join a growing area preparing for taking in more exciting development projects and expanding capacity for the supply of our portfolio. Your main tasks will be to:

• Ensure delivery according to ambitious production plans with a high level of quality

• Coordinate and engage in prioritization with your manager colleagues across the department to ensure high-quality level, production activities and team engagement.

• Continuously ensure high level of psychological safety, motivation and engagement in your team

• Day-to-day visible on shopfloor, engaging with your employees, in problem solving and identifying opportunities to optimize our workflow and processes through a structured approach.

As Sr Manager you will be part of the leadership team in CMC MPP, which is composed of 1 Director, 4 Sr Managers and an administrative coordinator that meets frequently, help and support each other, and routinely use each other as sparring partners.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you will need a technical background, master’s degree or PhD in science/technology, biochemical/chemical engineering, pharmacy, or other relevant fields. Furthermore, you will need:

• Experience in the pharma industry and knowledge of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) is preferred.

• Leadership experience and a natural desire to engage, develop and empower people.

• Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both internal and external collaboration partners.

• The ability to challenge status quo and see LEAN as a natural part of your daily work.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

You are a strong relationship builder who creates trust and followership within your team. You empower and involve your employees, lead with authenticity, and motivate others to deliver high-quality results. You thrive in a dynamic development environment with competing priorities and complex problem-solving. You balance leadership and operational management effectively and bring an innovative, flexible mindset.

**Who you’ll work with

**CMC Development's role in Novo's value chain is to turn molecules into approved products in close cooperation with our colleagues in R&ED, Development and Global Manufacturing and Supply.  As part of CMC Development, CMC API Pilots is the preferred partner for API production supporting clinical trials and ensuring process transfer to commercial production.

The CMC MPP department is organised within CMC API Pilots and we are 65 employees divided into four teams, three facilities, and two locations. Our primary task is to produce API for clinical studies supporting Novo’s important strategic projects within our mammalian platform.

What you can expect hereYou will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across areas. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from leadership colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

As our P&O Student Assistant, you will help keep People & Organisation (P&O) running smoothly. You will support a variety of activities across administration, communication and events, from welcoming new colleagues to keeping information accurate and easy to access. Along the way, we encourage you to bring your ideas and help us find smarter and simpler ways of working.

What you’ll bring

You are studying, curious and organised, and you like making things work for other people.

• Currently enrolled in a university or business school programme, preferably in your 2nd or 3rd year within human resources or a similar field.

• Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

• The ability to prioritise your studies alongside part-time work and meet deadlines without compromising quality.

• Attention to detail and accuracy when handling administrative information and following established guidelines.

• A proactive, can-do attitude, with the adaptability and learning agility to pick up new tasks, processes and digital tools quickly.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues.

Useful, but not essential:

Familiarity with HR activities or related tasks. Prior experience is preferred but not required.

What you’ll do

You will be the extra pair of hands and fresh pair of eyes that keeps P&O operations accurate, organised and moving.

• Keep P&O information accurate and accessible by updating SharePoint sites, managing content and permissions, and maintaining distribution lists and hierarchy overviews across affiliates.

• Create posts on Viva Engage and contribute to internal P&O communication, building a strong understanding of the organisational structure as you go.

• Support HR administration, including the archive, organisational organograms, and updates to employee information and organisational changes.

• Support onboarding and exit processes together with the P&O Partnering Professional, including IT system access, training schedules and orientation materials, as well as planning, coordination and booking for exits.

• Support the PA and Internal Communication Professional with company days, events, seminars, meetings and catering, and contribute ideas to process optimisation and digital tools that reduce complexity.

• Handle procurement and purchasing activities, including purchase orders, invoice follow-up and related administration.

• Support with general ad hoc tasks and activities across P&O.

Who you’ll work with

You will join People & Organisation within International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. You will report to the People and Organisation Director. As part of a team of five, you will work closely with the P&O Partnering Professional and the PA & Internal Communication Professional in your day-to-day role.

You will also collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders from different functions and affiliates, and take part in cross-functional discussions where we encourage you to bring your own ideas and perspectives. By staying organised, proactive and focused on priorities, you will help keep things moving and make a valuable contribution to the team.

What you can expect here

You will learn from experienced professionals and get a close view of how P&O supports a global organisation. You will build practical skills in HR administration, process improvement and internal communication, and be trusted to take ownership of your tasks and make your voice heard.

This is a one-year contract with the possibility of extension. The role is approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility to increase or reduce your hours depending on your studies.

Salary and Benefits

This position is hourly paid, and the hourly base rate is DKK 209,27. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure, curiosity and a can-do attitude to P&O, apply for the P&O Student Intern role by 30 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What if learning was not something you had to wait for?

As Director – Global Medical Learning, you will lead the shift from scheduled, content-led training to personalised, on-demand and AI-enabled learning that supports colleagues in the flow of their work. Whether someone is new to Medical Affairs, preparing for a launch or an important scientific conversation, or moving into a new disease area, the right knowledge, coaching or practice will be there when they need it. What you’ll bring

As Advanced IT Security Architect, you will take the lead on Application and DevSecOps Security and on AI Security within Defence Engineering. You will design and build the security capabilities that protect how Novo develops software and AI, from delivery pipelines to AI models, agents, workloads and data flows. Your work helps teams build and deploy with confidence, so technology can keep supporting people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You are hands-on, curious and ready to take ownership of a new area. We value technical depth and the right security mindset, and we are open on seniority depending on your expertise, potential and overall fit.

• A strong technical foundation in application development, the software development lifecycle, AppSec, DevSecOps or IT architecture.

• Proven experience in cybersecurity, ideally from several years in IT architecture, technical strategy or security roles. Candidates from application development or IT architecture backgrounds are welcome if they show the right security mindset.

• Experience designing and configuring IT systems, cloud infrastructure or integrations, and working with compliance and IT-risk assessment processes.

• Experience or a strong interest in AI security, including AI models, agents, workloads and data flows.

• Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as CIS, NIS2 and ISO 27001.

• The ability to make decisions, turn ideas into practical implementation, and influence and communicate with colleagues at different technical levels.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken, and a global mindset.

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Significant professional experience can be considered equivalent.

Useful, but not essential :

• Experience in the pharma industry or another large organisation.

• Knowledge of ITIL or broader IT processes, and familiarity with Agile ways of working.

• Experience from large-scale deployments across infrastructure.

What you’ll do

You will design, engineer and implement security capabilities, working directly with security tools rather than focusing mainly on governance or documentation.

• Lead and develop Application Security, DevSecOps and AI Security capabilities within the team, and act as the go-to expert and point of contact for these areas.

• Assess risks across applications, AI models, agents, workloads and data flows, using threat modelling and security design reviews of AI solutions, development platforms and CI/CD pipelines.

• Design and implement security architectures, policies and controls, including automated checks for code, dependencies, secrets, containers and infrastructure as code, and protections for AI-specific risks such as prompt injection and sensitive data exposure.

• Strengthen monitoring, alerting, detection and response for AI services, developer platforms and software supply chains.

• Test and validate controls through security testing and attack simulations, then measure and improve how well they work in practice.

• Assess emerging threats and technologies, and turn them into practical improvements, reusable engineering patterns and clear documentation for others.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Defence Engineering team and work with specialists across Cloud, Identity, Endpoint and Data Protection. Together, you will align defensive controls and close gaps across security domains.

Day to day, you will partner with AI, software engineering and DevOps teams to build security into development workflows. You will also work with Cyber Defence Centre, Security Operations and Incident Response colleagues to agree telemetry and detections, and with Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management teams to validate attack scenarios and verify fixes. Security Architecture, Governance, Risk and Compliance colleagues help ensure your work aligns with standards.

What you can expect here

You will join a large enterprise environment with broad exposure to major IT security technologies and highly skilled specialists across multiple security domains. You will have significant ownership and visibility, and the chance to establish yourself as the go-to expert in Application and AI Security, an area that is still taking shape.

You will be trusted to explore, decide and deliver, with colleagues who support you to perform at your best and grow your skills on the job.
